description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Anduril Industries is hiring an Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer for its Battlespace Awareness team. The role owns and improves CI/CD and integration test infrastructure for command-and-control software, and supports observability dashboards, metrics, and data pipelines.
Software Engineer, Infrastructure maintaining CI/CD, provisioning environments and releases with Terraform, RKE2, and ArgoCD, and building observability

Responsibilities:
• Maintain and improve the team's current CI/CD systems
• Help lead the team's infrastructure using: Terraform, RKE2, ArgoCD, alongside traditional DevOps work (build systems, environment provisioning, release engineering)
• Build and maintain Grafana dashboards and Prometheus metrics for system and test observability
• Support integration with the team's Data Lake for test and system performance data

Requirements:
• Experience with Kubernetes and/or Docker Compose in a production environment
• Experienced in GitHub branch management and release management practices
• Hands-on CI software testing experience, especially with CircleCI
• Experience with Grafana and Prometheus
• Experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and ArgoCD
• Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Claude or Codex) as part of your day-to-day workflow
• Proficient in Python or another object-oriented language
• Must be authorized to work in the United States
• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

Preferred:
• Experience with Helm, Terraform, RKE2, ArgoCD
• Experience with Robot Framework testing
• Familiarity with Data Lake architectures and tooling for metrics pipelines
• Familiarity with MCAP data and Foxglove
• Familiarity with Rust, C, or C++
• Familiarity with team collaboration tooling such as Slack and Slackbot CI development
